title: Oral Appliances for Sleep Apnea
subtitle: Definitions, symptoms, evaluation, management, safety, and evidence related to oral appliances for sleep apnea.
evidence_strength: Moderate evidence based on systematic reviews and clinical guidelines supports oral appliances as effective treatment for mild to moderate obstructive sleep apnea, with better compliance but lower efficacy compared to CPAP.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
